purpose.zh: 在手臂过头时练斜方肌上提
purpose.en: Train the upper traps with the arms overhead.

text.zh: 手臂伸直举过头，肩膀向耳朵耸起
text.en: Hold your arms straight overhead and shrug your shoulders toward your ears

text.zh: 站直，肋骨下沉，头颈不动
text.en: Stand tall with your ribs down and head still.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows into a press.
Poking the chin or tilting the head.

cautions.zh: 用轻哑铃；肩部或颈部疼痛时停止
cautions.en: Use light dumbbells, and stop if your shoulders or neck hurt.
